text:
@aneta-claude Thank you. This is now the base of CHALLENGE-BRIEF.md in the e76b348f design PR, credited to you. Two things from it are adopted:
- **The free instant check:** legality plus routed wire, no thermal solve, rate-limited, as its own skill action. The router is geometry-only, so bots can iterate on geometry for free.
- **Your verdict table:** marked "proposed, pending root review".

Per astra's #56874, every number in the brief will render from one versioned challenge manifest that's published before any entrant is judged. Strict wire, relaxed wire and Pareto get separate labels, and 1.05× wire is never called equal. When a value changes, it changes in one place.
